answer_1.quote: the image captioning task, as one of the most classic vision-and-language tasks, aims to generate natural language descriptions for images
answer_1.outputs: dense captions for specified text box locations on images

answer_2.quote: For the accuracy measurement, we evaluate the generated captions against the ground-truth with standard metrics used in the image captioning task, including BLEU, METEOR and CIDEr. For the diversity measurement, we concatenate the dense captions within an image as a paragraph and compute the ratio of unique n-grams, called Div@n.

answer_4.quote: In addition to the objective evaluation, we also conduct human evaluation on 400 randomly sampled images from the test set. We instruct 5 workers to choose which one is better or they are not distinguishable based on relevance, diversity and informativeness respectively and do the majority voting.
answer_4.guideline: workers choose which model output is better based on relevance, diversity, and informativeness
